title: Web Summit returns in-person with more than 40,000 expected (The Irish Times, 2021)
what_it_says: The Irish Times, in the week of the 2021 Lisbon edition, reports more than 40,000 people expected, down from the 70,469 attendees of 2019, an in-person edition that organisers say is sold out, with Covid restrictions, and about 104,000 people who tuned in to the 2020 online event.
status: publication date not shown on the page as fetched; the text places it in 2021
